site.title: Crochet Pattern Shop
site.description: Complete shop for crochet pattern designers: 36 pattern pages (amigurumi animals and birds, pet accessories, blankets, wearables, home decor, seasonal, bags, car accessories), US/UK terms and video options, bundles, a crochet help page with stitch terms and hook sizes, FAQ and contact.
site.hero_title: Crochet patterns you will love to make
site.hero_text: Clear, photo-rich PDF patterns for amigurumi, blankets, wearables and home decor, in US and UK terms. Download instantly and start tonight.
site.trending_text: Granny squares, temperature blankets, bucket hats and cuddly amigurumi.
site.shop_intro: PDF patterns with step photos, charts and US and UK terms.

amigurumi: Cuddly toys with step photos for every round.
blankets: From weekend chunky throws to heirloom granny squares.
wearables: Beanies, cardigans, scarves and hats in many sizes.
car: Mirror charms, steering wheel covers, seat belt covers and cup holder coasters.
pets: Dog sweaters, bandanas, cat toys and cosy pet beds.

promises: Your pattern arrives right after checkout. Edit to match your checkout.
Choose your terms at checkout; charts are included where useful.
Photos for the tricky parts, plus video options on many patterns.
Stuck on a row? Tell customers how to reach you.

faq.How do I get my pattern?: Right after checkout you receive a download link by email and on the order page. Edit this to match your checkout provider.
faq.US or UK terms?: Most patterns come in both. Choose your terms in the options, or see the Crochet help page for a conversion chart.
faq.Can I sell items I make from your patter: Yes, you may sell finished items you make by hand; please credit the designer. Sharing, reselling or translating the pattern itself is not allowed.
faq.I am stuck on a row. Can you help?: Yes. Send the pattern name and the row number through the contact page. Write your real reply time here.
faq.What is your refund policy?: Write your refund policy for digital patterns here.
faq.Is this a physical product?: No. These are PDF patterns. Yarn and hooks are not included.

levels: Basic stitches only: chains, single crochet and simple shaping. Good first projects.
Basic stitches, repeated patterns, simple colour changes and shaping.
A variety of stitches and techniques, such as lace, simple colourwork and working in the round.
Complex stitches and techniques, detailed shaping and refined finishing.

help_page: Stitch terms in US and UK, hook sizes and skill levels in one place.
